questions.text: According to the CAG report 'State Finances 2024-25', what was the total combined liability of all 28 Indian states as of March 31, 2025?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Rs 90.51 lakh crore

In News

  • The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India, K Sanjay Murthy, released the report titled 'State Finances 2024-25', which provides a decade-long assessment of state finances from 2015-16 to 2024-25.

Key Points

  • The report highlighted that the combined liabilities of all 28 states rose to Rs 90.51 lakh crore as of March 31, 2025.
  • In the financial year 2024-25, all 28 states reported fiscal deficits, showing deep fiscal stress across the country.
  • Out of these 28 states, 15 states recorded a fiscal deficit above 3 per cent of their Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP).
  • The report noted that while revenue mobilisation improved, the growing fiscal burden remains a challenge due to high levels of committed liabilities.

Additional Information

  • States' Own Tax Revenue (SOTR): Accounted for nearly 50% of the combined revenue receipts of Rs 40.52 lakh crore in 2024-25.
  • State GST: It contributed more than 43% of the total own tax revenues, showing an improved growth in tax collections post-GST.
  • Expenditure Patterns: The combined budgetary expenditure of all states was Rs 51.20 lakh crore, with revenue expenditure making up nearly 80% of total spending.

Important Points

  • Nagaland had the highest committed expenditure at 74% of its revenue expenditure, whereas Maharashtra had the lowest at 29%.
  • Subsidies alone accounted for over 10% of revenue expenditure in 2024-25.
  • The Economic sector accounted for 63% of total capital outlay, with a focus on infrastructure, while Education remained the largest head among functional sectors.

questions.text: Which Gram Panchayat has been conferred the Gold Award under the category 'Grassroots-Level Initiatives by Gram Panchayats' at the National Awards for e-Governance (NAeG) 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Kadepur Gram Panchayat

In News

  • The Ministry of Panchayati Raj announced that four Panchayati Raj-related initiatives have been selected for the National Awards for e-Governance (NAeG) 2026.
  • The awards will be presented at the 29th National Conference on e-Governance in Jaipur, Rajasthan, scheduled for 1–2 July 2026.

Key Points

  • Kadepur Gram Panchayat (Maharashtra): Located in Sangli District, it won the Gold Award for its end-to-end digital governance ecosystem, delivering over 1,355 services online and adopting policies on AI, Blockchain, and Robotics.
  • Bijoy Nagar Gram Panchayat (Tripura): Located in West Tripura District, it secured the Silver Award in the same category for its participatory governance and achieving 100% digital literacy among women.
  • Rohini Gram Panchayat (Maharashtra): This panchayat was the Gold Awardee in the same category in the previous year, NAeG 2025.
  • West Majlishpur Gram Panchayat (Tripura): This panchayat was the Silver Awardee in the NAeG 2025 cycle.

Additional Information

  • The conference theme is “Viksit Bharat 2047: AI-Enabled, Data-Driven and Secure Digital Governance.”
  • It is jointly organized by the DARPG, MeitY, and the Government of Rajasthan.
  • Incentives: Gold Awardees receive ₹10 lakhs, while Silver Awardees receive ₹5 lakhs for project implementation or welfare.

Important Points

  • Panchayat Advancement Index (PAI): An initiative of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj, it won the Gold Award at the National Level for Data-Driven Governance.
  • e-Aarogya Dhamni: An initiative by Zilla Parishad Nandurbar (Maharashtra), it won the Gold Award for District-Level Initiatives in e-Governance.
  • The dedicated Gram Panchayat category was introduced for the first time in NAeG 2025.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the GARUDA (Green-Channel: AIF Rollout Upon Document Acknowledgement) mechanism recently approved by SEBI:

A. Under the GARUDA mechanism, Regular Schemes of Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) will benefit from a compressed 10-working-day approval window.
B. Under the prior regulatory regime, fund managers faced a rigid 30-day waiting period alongside high compliance costs.
C. Angel Funds and Accredited Investor-only schemes must now obtain mandatory merchant banker certification before launch.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

options.text: A and B only, but with a 15-working-day approval window instead of 10 days.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is A and B only

In News

  • The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has approved the GARUDA mechanism to overhaul the Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) framework.

Key Points

  • Statement A is correct: Under the overhauled structure, Regular Schemes of AIFs will benefit from a vastly compressed 10-working-day approval window.
  • Statement B is correct: Under the prior (static) regime, fund managers faced a rigid 30-day waiting period and high compliance costs driven by merchant banker diligence.
  • Statement C is incorrect: Angel Funds and Accredited Investor-only (AI-only) schemes can now launch immediately once the Private Placement Memorandum (PPM) is filed, completely bypassing the previously mandatory merchant banker certification.

Additional Information

  • The GARUDA mechanism transitions the AIF framework from a traditional pre-clearance model to a fast-track, accountability-driven disclosure model.
  • For specialized funds like Angel Funds, the responsibility of compliance shifts to self-certification by the fund’s CEO and Compliance Officer.

Important Points

  • Large Value Funds (LVFs) will continue to operate under their pre-existing fast-track waivers.
  • The liability for misleading or incomplete disclosures now falls directly on fund managers due to the reduction in upfront vetting for sophisticated investors.

questions.text: Which of the following portals was launched by Union Minister Shri Amit Shah specifically for the inventory management of pulses and oilseeds?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is DRISHTI

In News

  • Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah is scheduled to launch several digital and farmer-centric initiatives of NAFED, including the DRISHTI portal, on 23 June 2026 in New Delhi.

Key Points

  • DRISHTI portal: This specific portal has been designed for the inventory management of pulses and oilseeds to bring more efficiency to NAFED's operations.
  • NAFEX.in: This is an auction portal aimed at strengthening transparency and digital processes in agricultural produce auctions.
  • NAFED-KALYAN: This is a scholarship scheme intended to support the education of farmers' children.
  • ERP portal: This portal focuses on strengthening enterprise resource planning within the organization.
  • The launch of these initiatives is part of the government's effort to modernize cooperative institutions through technology and transparency.

Additional Information

  • The event is held at Atal Akshay Urja Bhawan, New Delhi, with the presence of Union Minister of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
  • The leadership of NAFED attending includes Chairman Shri Jethabhai Ahir and Managing Director Shri Deepak Agarwal.
  • The initiatives align with the Prime Minister's vision of "Sahkar Se Samriddhi" (Prosperity through Cooperation).

Important Points

  • NAFEX.in specifically targets transparency and ease of operations in the auctioning process for stakeholders.
  • The NAFED-KALYAN initiative involves the distribution of scholarship cheques to children of farmers during the launch program.
  • A live registration demonstration on the auction portal marks the formal commencement of the digital auction process.

questions.text: According to the 8th edition of NITI Aayog's 'Trade Watch Quarterly' report, what was India's position among the world's largest services exporters in 2025?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Eighth-largest

In News

  • Shri Ashok Kumar Lahiri, Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog, released the eighth edition of the “Trade Watch Quarterly” for Quarter 4 of FY’2025-26 in New Delhi.

Key Points

  • India retained its position as the world’s eighth-largest services exporter in 2025.
  • The report highlights that services trade remained a key source of strength, with services exports growing by 9.0% during Q4 FY’2025–26.
  • This growth in services outpaced import growth, helping to sustain a strong services surplus for the nation.
  • The other options (Fifth, Tenth, Sixth) are incorrect based on the data provided in the report which explicitly mentions the 8th position.

Additional Information

  • India's services exports recorded a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 10.3% during the decade 2015–2025, which is significantly higher than the global average.
  • India’s total merchandise and services trade reached $1.84 trillion during FY2025–26, expanding by 5.4% year-on-year.
  • The thematic focus of this edition is the pharmaceutical sector, identifying it as a strategic pillar of the Indian economy.

Important Points

  • Overall exports for FY2025–26 grew by 4.2%, while imports increased by 6.5%.
  • The pharmaceutical sector analysis shows that while India is a leader in generic medicines, global demand for APIs and pharma products is estimated at $1.3 trillion, with India's share being $35.8 billion.
  • Telangana, Gujarat, and Maharashtra were identified as the key pillars driving India’s pharmaceutical industry production and exports.

questions.text: India and France have partnered for the joint TRISHNA satellite mission which is designed to contribute significantly to global water and food security. During his address to the Indian diaspora in Paris, in which year did Prime Minister Narendra Modi announce this mission would be launched?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 2027

In News

  • Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced that India and France will jointly launch the TRISHNA satellite in 2027.

Key Points

  • The TRISHNA satellite mission is specifically designed to contribute to global water and food security.
  • The announcement was made by the Prime Minister while addressing the Indian diaspora in Paris during the final leg of his visit to France and Slovakia.
  • The project is described as a natural extension of the cooperation demonstrated at the AI Summits co-hosted in Paris and Delhi.
  • Therefore, the scheduled launch year is 2027, making option 3 the correct choice.

Additional Information

  • The Bharat Innovates program held in Nice featured 120 leading Indian deep tech startups and facilitated approximately 1,400 B2B meetings.
  • India has successfully created unique digital health IDs for around 90 crore citizens to ensure secure healthcare delivery.
  • PM Modi also addressed VivaTech 2026, which is one of Europe’s largest technology and innovation conferences.

Important Points

  • During the G7 meeting in Evian, PM Modi emphasized partnerships based on trust and inclusive global governance.
  • He highlighted that global growth must be shared to be sustainable and technology must be trusted to benefit humanity.

questions.text: Regarding the recently launched indigenous AI model Varya, developed by Avataar.ai under the IndiaAI Mission, what is the specific efficiency gain achieved in the video generation process?

options.text: Reduction of generation steps from 100 steps to 10 steps
Reduction of generation steps from 50 steps to 4 steps
Reduction of generation steps from 25 steps to 2 steps
Reduction of generation steps from 75 steps to 15 steps
Reduction of generation steps from 60 steps to 8 steps

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Reduction of generation steps from 50 steps to 4 steps

In News

  • The Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY), under the IndiaAI Mission, launched Varya, an indigenous video story generating AI model developed by Avataar.ai.

Key Points

  • Varya is a distilled video model designed to make high-quality video AI affordable and accessible for India's population scale.
  • The model uses a distillation technique that significantly optimizes performance by reducing the video generation process from the standard 50 steps to just 4 steps.
  • This reduction makes the model ten times more efficient than several leading global video models currently in the market.
  • By skipping redundant computations through the student-teacher model replication, Varya maintains high output quality while drastically lowering the inference cost.

Additional Information

  • The model can generate video at a highly affordable rate of ₹0.48 per second.
  • It was unveiled in New Delhi in the presence of Shri S. Krishnan, Secretary, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
  • Avataar.ai was selected by the IndiaAI Mission to build indigenous foundation AI capabilities, utilizing subsidized national AI compute infrastructure.
  • The product workflow is designed around the promise: Idea → Video → Story, allowing users to convert text prompts or images into videos.

Important Points

  • Distilled Video Generation: A compression technique where a compact student model replicates a larger teacher model to eliminate redundant steps.
  • Varya is claimed to be India's first distilled video model, marking a milestone in frugal innovation and deep-tech ecosystem development.

questions.text: Which country officially became the 10th member of the New Development Bank (NDB) and the first from the Central Asian region in June 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Uzbekistan

In News

  • The Republic of Uzbekistan has officially joined the New Development Bank (NDB) as a shareholder, effective from June 5, 2026.

Key Points

  • Uzbekistan has become the 10th member of the NDB and is the first country from Central Asia to join the institution.
  • The membership became effective after the country ratified the NDB Articles of Agreement and fulfilled all necessary requirements on June 5, 2026.
  • Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev signed the law for accession on May 21, aiming to expand trade, economic, and investment cooperation.
  • The NDB plans to explore investment projects in Uzbekistan later this year, focusing on energy, water management, transport, and municipal infrastructure.
  • Between 2023 and 2025, Uzbekistan's economy showed strong performance with an average annual growth of more than 6.7 per cent.

Additional Information

  • The New Development Bank (NDB) was established in 2015 by the BRICS nations (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa).
  • As of June 2026, the NDB has approved 139 projects worth approximately US $43 billion.
  • Beyond the founding BRICS members, the bank now includes Egypt, the UAE, Bangladesh, Algeria, and Uzbekistan.

Important Points

  • The NDB intends to use its strengths such as financing in national currencies and applying national procurement procedures for its operations in Uzbekistan.
  • Andrey Bokarev, Director General of the NDB Eurasian Regional Centre, noted that Central Asia is one of the world's most dynamically developing regions.

questions.text: Who has been re-appointed as the Solicitor General (SG) of India for a further term of three years starting from July 1, 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Tushar Mehta

In News

  • The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) has approved the re-appointment of senior advocate Tushar Mehta as the Solicitor General (SG) of India for a further term of three years.

Key Points

  • Tushar Mehta has been re-appointed as the Union Government's second-highest law officer.
  • His fresh term will take effect from July 1, 2026.
  • The other options provided, such as Shri Suryaprakash V. Raju and Shri N. Venkataraman, have been re-appointed as Additional Solicitor Generals (ASGs), not the Solicitor General.
  • Shri Vikramji Banerjee has been re-appointed as an Additional Solicitor General for the Supreme Court.

Additional Information

  • Tushar Mehta assumed the Solicitor General office in 2018 and is set to complete eleven years in this role by the end of his new tenure.
  • The ACC also extended the tenure of Additional Solicitor Generals including Ms. Aishwarya Bhati and Shri K.M. Nataraj for three years.
  • Shri Chetan Sharma was re-appointed as ASG for the High Court of Delhi for a term of six months effective from July 1, 2026.

Important Points

  • The Solicitor General is the second-highest law officer in India, subordinate to the Attorney General.
  • The appointments of high-ranking law officers are processed through the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions and approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet.

questions.text: Who was honored with the prestigious Global Prestige Award at the House of Lords, UK Parliament, in June 2026 for contributions toward the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Harsh Vardhan

In News

  • Bihar Cricket Association (BCA) President Harsh Vardhan was recently honored with the Global Prestige Award at the House of Lords, UK Parliament.

Key Points

  • Harsh Vardhan, the President of the Bihar Cricket Association, received the award for his contribution towards the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047.
  • The theme of the event was "Visionaries of Change: Charting the Course to Viksit Bharat 2047," which celebrated Indian leaders working towards transforming India by the centenary of its independence.
  • He made history as the youngest President in the history of the Bihar Cricket Association after being elected unopposed in September 2025.
  • The other options like Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Akshara Gupta are emerging cricketers from Bihar but were not the recipients of this specific leadership award. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is a rising star, while Akshara Gupta recently made news for scoring an unbeaten 306 runs in a domestic tournament.

Additional Information

  • The Global Prestige Award recognizes individuals worldwide for leadership, innovation, and dedication to global peace and development.
  • Under Harsh Vardhan's leadership, the BCA has focused on grassroots development and building a strong sporting ecosystem in Bihar.
  • Akshara Gupta's record-breaking innings of 306 runs included 55 fours and 8 sixes at a strike rate of 242.86.

Important Points

  • The award ceremony took place at the House of Lords, UK Parliament on June 20, 2026.
  • The primary goal of the recognition was to celebrate Indian changemakers contributing to a developed India (Viksit Bharat) by 2047.

questions.text: Which company was recently upgraded to become the 28th Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) in India?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd

In News

  • Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd (CPCL) has been officially upgraded to Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) status.

Key Points

  • The upgrade was approved by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and announced by the Department of Public Enterprises (DPE).
  • With this elevation, CPCL becomes the 28th Navratna enterprise among all CPSEs in India.
  • The company previously held Miniratna Category-I status and operates under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
  • In FY 2025-26, CPCL recorded an annual turnover of Rs 59,400 crore.
  • The Navratna tag grants the company greater financial and operational autonomy, allowing it to invest up to Rs 1,000 crore or 15% of its net worth on a single project without prior government approval.

Additional Information

  • CPCL (formerly Madras Refineries Limited) was formed in 1965 as a joint venture.
  • It became a subsidiary of Indian Oil Corporation (IOCL) in 2001, with IOCL currently holding a 51.89% stake.
  • The company's primary facility is the Manali refinery in South India, which has an installed refining capacity of 10.5 MMTPA.

Important Points

  • To qualify for Navratna status, a CPSE must be a Miniratna-I entity, have a positive net worth, and score 60 or more points on key financial indicators.
  • CPCL produces specialized products like JP-5 fuel for fighter jets and missile fuels.

questions.text: Which organization organized the International Business Summit & Awards 2026 that recently concluded in Jaipur?

options.text: National Institute for Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development
Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry
Small Industries Development Bank of India

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Indian Council for Entrepreneurship & Innovation (ICEI)

In News

  • The International Business Summit & Awards 2026 concluded successfully in Jaipur, Rajasthan, after three days of leadership sessions and networking.

Key Points

  • The event was organized by the Indian Council for Entrepreneurship & Innovation (ICEI) to strengthen India’s growing startup and MSME ecosystem.
  • The summit brought together over 150 entrepreneurs, startup founders, and MSME leaders from more than 15 states across India.
  • The inaugural ceremony was graced by Smt. Manju Sharma, Hon’ble Member of Lok Sabha, who served as the Chief Guest and emphasized the role of innovation in India’s development.
  • The event provided a platform for business collaboration, investment opportunities, and leadership development over its three-day duration.

Additional Information

  • The Founders of ICEI are CA Abhishek Jain and Puneet Sethi.
  • The summit featured prestigious ICEI honours, including the Diamond, Gold, and Silver Honours, recognizing excellence across diverse industries.
  • Distinguished speakers like Dr. Sanjay Kathuria and Basesh Gala shared insights on digital transformation and working capital management during the first day.

Important Points

  • A Live Startup Pitching Session was a major highlight, where more than 20 startups presented ideas to a panel of esteemed investors including Anil Joshi and Mahavir Pratap Sharma.
  • The concluding day featured Shri Suresh Singh Rawat, Hon’ble Cabinet Minister for Water Resources Department, Government of Rajasthan, as the Chief Guest.

questions.text: What is the total route length sanctioned for the installation of the Kavach system in the Ambala Division of Northern Railway, as per the recent approval in June 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 811 route kilometres

In News

  • Indian Railways has approved the installation of the Kavach system for the Ahmedabad Division and the Ambala Division to enhance rail safety.

Key Points

  • Ambala Division Project: Indian Railways has sanctioned the installation of Kavach on the balance Broad Gauge sections of the Ambala Division (Northern Railway) covering 811 route kilometres. Hence, the correct answer is 811 route kilometres.
  • The project for the Ambala Division has been sanctioned at a cost of ₹201 crore.
  • Ahmedabad Division Project: In a separate approval, Kavach Version 4.0 was sanctioned for 598 route kilometres of the Ahmedabad Division (Western Railway) at a cost of ₹140 crore.
  • The Ahmedabad project covers 48 block sections, and previously 702 route kilometres had already been sanctioned in this division.
  • Kavach System: It is an indigenously developed Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system designed to prevent Signal Passing at Danger (SPAD) and reduce the risk of collisions.

Additional Information

  • The work is being executed under an umbrella programme featuring an LTE-based communication backbone.
  • The Ambala Division routes connect key states including Haryana, Punjab, and Himachal Pradesh.
  • Specific sections in Ambala include Ambala Cantonment–Ludhiana, Kalka–Chandigarh–New Morinda–Sahnewal, and Rajpura–Bathinda–Shri Ganganagar.

Important Points

  • Kavach automatically applies brakes when required to avert unsafe situations and controls train speed in critical conditions.
  • The system is part of Indian Railways' effort to modernise train operations on high-density and strategically important routes.

questions.text: Based on the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) data for May 2026, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: The overall unemployment rate at the national level in May 2026 was estimated at 5.5 per cent, remaining unchanged from May 2025.
The urban unemployment rate for persons aged 15 years and above declined to 6.4 per cent in May 2026 compared to 6.9 per cent in May 2025.
In May 2026, the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) was recorded at 49.8 per cent in rural areas and 56.6 per cent in urban areas.
The overall Worker Population Ratio (WPR) for May 2026 was estimated at 51.4 per cent, showing a decline from 52.2 per cent in April 2026.
The gender gap in the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) narrowed significantly in May 2026, with female LFPR surpassing male LFPR for the first time.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is In May 2026, the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) was recorded at 49.8 per cent in rural areas and 56.6 per cent in urban areas.

In News

  • The National Statistical Office (NSO) released the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) data for May 2026, showing overall steady unemployment at 5.5%.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: The overall unemployment rate at the national level was estimated at 5.5 per cent in May 2026, which remained unchanged compared to the corresponding month in 2025.
  • Statement 2 is correct: The urban unemployment rate for persons aged 15 years and above fell to 6.4 per cent in May 2026 from 6.9 per cent in May 2025.
  • Statement 3 is incorrect: According to the data, the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) was recorded at 56.6 per cent in rural areas and 49.8 per cent in urban areas. The statement incorrectly swaps these figures.
  • Statement 4 is correct: The Worker Population Ratio (WPR), which measures the proportion of employed persons, was estimated at 51.4 per cent in May 2026, down from 52.2 per cent in April 2026.

Additional Information

  • The rural unemployment rate increased marginally to 5.1 per cent in May 2026 from 4.6 per cent in April.
  • The urban female LFPR stood at 24.8 per cent in May 2026, while the overall female LFPR was recorded at 32.8 per cent.
  • The monthly estimates are based on information collected from 3,73,887 individuals across India.

Important Points

  • The PLFS is conducted by the National Statistical Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.
  • Since January 2025, the survey methodology has been revised to provide monthly and quarterly labour market estimates at the national level.

questions.text: The late Professor Robert A.F. Thurman, a Padma Shri awardee who recently passed away, was a prominent scholar associated with which specific field of study?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Indo-Tibetan Buddhist Studies

In News

  • Renowned American scholar Professor Robert A.F. Thurman, a Padma Shri awardee and noted Buddhist scholar, passed away at the age of 84 in Woodstock, New York.

Key Points

  • Robert A.F. Thurman was the Jey Tsong Khapa Professor of Indo-Tibetan Buddhist Studies in the Department of Religion at Columbia University.
  • He was a co-founder and President of Tibet House US and the American Institute of Buddhist Studies.
  • The Indian government conferred the Padma Shri upon him in recognition of his lifelong dedication to Indo-Tibetan Buddhist studies and his role in bringing Buddhist wisdom to global audiences.
  • He was particularly recognized for translating and interpreting Tibetan Buddhist philosophical and religious texts, including the Vimalakirti Sutra from the Tibetan Kagyur.

Additional Information

  • Thurman was a longtime friend of the Dalai Lama and the father of Hollywood actress Uma Thurman.
  • In 1997, he was named among the 25 most influential Americans by Time magazine, and in 2006, New York Magazine included him among its influential religious figures.
  • Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Professor Thurman in New York in June 2023 to discuss how Buddhist values could address global challenges.

Important Points

  • The Consulate General of India in New York described him as one of the world’s foremost scholars of Buddhism and a great friend of India.
  • His academic work significantly contributed to the dissemination of Tibetan Buddhism and the preservation of India’s spiritual heritage.
